title: The Light setting draws the town far more cheaply from the prairie
items: On the Light setting, building details smaller than a pixel on your screen are no longer drawn, so phones and weaker machines do much less work for the same picture.

Looking at the town from the west prairie, Light now draws 23% fewer pieces on a phone and 9% fewer on a laptop. In a held frame, 14 pixels of the phone's 304,200 change, and 1 of the laptop's 1,024,000.
Full and Balanced still draw every piece.
